measurable.instructions: `item.text` is one non-functional requirement record as JSON. Does every MUST and MUST NOT statement give a quantity, limit or condition that can be measured?

criteria.yes: Each statement names what is measured and the value or condition that passes.
criteria.no: At least one statement names a quality (fast, reliable, secure) with no measure.
criteria.unclear: A measure is implied but not stated.

testable.instructions: `item.text` is one non-functional requirement record as JSON. Can each statement be checked as pass or fail by a test, run or inspection?

criteria.yes: Each statement has a check whose result is pass or fail.
criteria.no: At least one statement could not be checked by any test, run or inspection.
criteria.unclear: It is not possible to tell how a statement would be checked.

atomic.instructions: `item.text` is one non-functional requirement record as JSON. Does each MUST and MUST NOT statement impose exactly one constraint?

criteria.yes: Every statement asks for one thing.
criteria.no: At least one statement joins two or more independent obligations.
criteria.unclear: It is not possible to tell how many obligations a statement holds.

criteria.instructions: `item.text` is one non-functional requirement record as JSON. Do its acceptance criteria test the measures its statements set?

criteria.yes: Each criterion checks a stated measure, and each measure has a criterion.
criteria.no: A measure has no criterion, or a criterion checks something no statement sets.
criteria.unclear: The criteria are too vague to match against the statements.

scope.instructions: `item.text` is one non-functional requirement record as JSON. Does it say which system, component or condition the measures apply to?

criteria.yes: The record names where and when each measure applies.
criteria.no: A reader cannot tell what the measures apply to.
criteria.unclear: The scope is implied but not stated.

testable.reason: A statement has no observable pass or fail outcome.

atomic.reason: A statement holds more than one constraint.

criteria.reason: The acceptance criteria do not match the measures.

criteria-unclear.reason: Jev could not match the acceptance criteria to the measures.

scope.reason: The record does not say what the measures apply to.

pass.reason: Every question in the path passed.
